mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting tissue spaces to lymphatic capillaries was most worthwhile: the planned closeup explains how fluid and proteins enter through flaps and become lymph.

leastWorthwhile.text: The collecting-route and venous-junction constructions felt somewhat repetitive; both mainly extended arrows along an already clear path.

surprise.text: The supplied-body model showed fluid accumulating when return was inadequate, making lymph drainage more consequential than just another vessel connection.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though combining the nervous framework with the breathing apparatus also supplied blood vessels to the arm and neural tissues—more than I expected from the item names.

continue.text: Yes, I would choose to continue: connecting the systems and tracing fluid back to the blood made their interdependence concrete, although the intermediate route-building became repetitive.
